summary: A great daily: everyone knows Musk, Bezos and Zuckerberg, Page and Brin are a fun 'oh right' pair, and Bill Gates missing out is a talking point. Its weak spot is that near misses like Gates and Ballmer show no rank.
reasons: Casual player found 9/10 losing 3 lives (Bill Gates, Mukesh Ambani, Steve Ballmer); only Amancio Ortega stayed hidden, a fair stretch.
Celebrity billionaires (Taylor Swift) and non-listed names (Jack Ma) are now free, and the junk relative aliases are gone, so the old traps are fixed.
No ranks 11+: Gates, Ballmer, Dell and Ambani cost a life with only 'outside the ranking', the same as a 1987 Japanese tycoon.
fixes: Add ranks 11+ of the Forbes 2026 list (at least to #20) from a source that has them, so misses like Michael Dell, Steve Ballmer, Bill Gates, the Waltons and Mukesh Ambani show their rank.
Source metadata says 'data as of 2025' while the prompt says 'Forbes 2026 list'; set dataAsOf to 2026.

Make deceased historical extras free rather than costly (Sam Walton, Paul Allen, Ingvar Kamprad, David Koch, Sheldon Adelson, Karl and Theo Albrecht), so that a bare first name such as 'karl' (which resolves to Karl Albrecht) no longer costs a life.
Add 'Rob Walton' as an alias of S. Robson Walton (not recognized now), and 'Gautam Adani' as an accepted answer.
